items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 乍 in Shuowen seal-script style, illustrating the conventional later form associated with the proposed relationship between 乍 and 作.

limitations.text: The selected image is a modern vector redraw of a seal-script form, not a photograph or facsimile of a dated artifact; it cannot demonstrate the contested oracle-bone graphic origin or the proposed garment/vegetation referent.
